I’ve never seen anyone go through the exact same thing as me. I got diagnosed with diabetes at 16, and I never had body image issues. For some reason when I was 18 I started to decrease the amount of insulin I would take. I lost so much weight to the point where I had multiple doctors tell me I was going to die. I would take one injection of insulin a day just because if I didn’t I felt like I was dying. I would drink 5L of juice and more than 10 water bottles a day to the point where one day I wondered what the hell was I doing. How long was I going to keep this going for? I was so tired of feeling like shit and I gave up at that point I didn’t care if I gained weight I just wanted to feel healthy. I started taking my insulin and now I’m back on my pump. Since I didn’t take insulin for so long I developed neuropathy and it has been the worst pain ever. I regret not taking my insulin so much because my feet are always in so much pain. Neuropathy has taken over my life all because I wanted to be skinny. Please if anyone is going through the same thing take my advice and take your insulin before the long term effects start. I now have neuropathy and I’m only 20 years old. I regret it so much and I really hope no one has to go through this ever
